title: Tabletop Grand Prix
author: NOVA-16
description: Toy cars race across the breakfast table and the garage workbench, for 1 to 4 players. The camera follows the leader: drop off the screen and you are out of the round, the last car left scores a point, and the first to five wins the race. Two cups of four tracks, with milk spills, crumbs, oil and jumps between tables.
